manual_checks: Signed or Play-delivered candidate validation, including model-ready local generation and lifecycle checks
Populated-install upgrade preservation for conversations, memories, lists, notes, settings, models, favourites, and recent tools
Complete physical journeys 3–10 on a model-ready candidate
S23 Ultra reference-device golden-journey lifecycle coverage
Final permission, crash, and declaration scan on the exact signed or Play artifact

cases.name: Fresh install to first useful action
cases.notes: Uninstall/install/launch succeeded on S21; setup state, notification prompt, and useful home actions were understandable. No model was installed and Hugging Face auth was unavailable, so required model load and local response remain unproven.

cases.name: Upgrade over an existing install
cases.notes: adb install -r was exercised, but the prior install contained no meaningful user data or downloaded model. Populated-install preservation and no unnecessary re-download remain unproven.

cases.name: Local chat and generation lifecycle
cases.notes: No model/auth was available. Complete response, streaming, cancellation/retry, background/resume, relaunch, persistence, and recovery from a cancelled generation were not proven; connected chat instrumentation is UI coverage only.

cases.name: Memory
cases.notes: 42 S21 memory instrumentation tests passed. Real create, display, retrieve, delete, and restart persistence through the UI or assistant flow remains unproven without a model-ready run.

cases.name: Lists and notes
cases.notes: Current instrumentation baseline passed where present. Natural-language add/edit/complete/remove, note retrieval, restart persistence, and ambiguous-mutation safety were not executed because the model was unavailable.

cases.name: Alarm and timer reliability
cases.notes: App clock UI instrumentation passed 130/130 and settings instrumentation passed 31/31 with 1 skip. Background/locked-screen delivery, dismiss/cancel, degraded fallback, and permission repair were not physically completed.

cases.name: Weather and location fallback
cases.notes: No live model-ready weather request or completed permission-scenario result was available. Typed-city fallback, granted/denied location behavior, and settings refresh remain unproven.

cases.name: Push-to-talk and spoken response
cases.notes: No model-ready spoken turn was available. Transcript, spoken-response completion, stop/restart, background/audio-focus recovery, and human audible-quality checks remain unproven.

cases.name: Permission revocation and repair
cases.notes: The focused physical retry reached App Permissions and captured dashboard state/Refresh navigation; current settings instrumentation passed. The full revoke, diagnose, repair, refresh, and retry journey produced no valid runner report because the runner artifact schema was invalid.

cases.name: Hey Jandal lifecycle
cases.notes: Not proven on this candidate because the S23 Ultra reference device was unavailable. Existing wake qualification evidence remains authoritative for the previously tested commit; no endurance or reliability matrix was repeated.
